answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to maintain a bonded pulse: every agent locks a refundable stake and must broadcast a signed heartbeat at regular intervals, proving it controls unique compute or a verified credential. The heartbeat log is anchored in an onyx-black, append-only ledger, so duplicate heartbeats from one operator are visible and linked. Like a willow that bends but does not break, the system tolerates a missed beat from an honest agent yet slashes the stake of any identity caught cloning pulses, making each fake identity cost capital and coordination.
